It introduces a new way of hotel living for both short and long stays. The property has 151 studios and apartments with one to three bedrooms. Each unit offers spacious living space. Therefore, guests enjoy comfort and convenience. The location is excellent. It is close to Keangnam Landmark Tower, My Dinh Stadium, and only 30 minutes from Noi Bai International Airport. Stylish Comfort for Every Stay Guests can choose studios, one-bedroom, or two-bedroom suites. Each unit has a smart layout, modern décor, and a kitchenette. For this reason, Novotel Suites Hanoi is ideal for: Families looking for a family-friendly hotel in Hanoi Business travelers needing a long-stay hotel near Keangnam Expats searching for a serviced apartment in Cau Giay For more details, please explore our Rooms & Suites section An Exquisite Taste Experience Food Exchange restaurant serves Vietnamese specialties and international cuisine. In addition, guests can enjoy Chinese and Korean dishes. These choices highlight the diverse community of Hanoi. That is why dining here feels both global and local. Explore our F&B promotion here. A Journey to Wellness Furthermore, guests may relax at In Balance Fitness & Wellness. The gym, sauna, and outdoor pool provide the perfect way to recharge. Elegant Venues for Success Novotel Suites Hanoi provides modern meeting rooms with advanced technology. Therefore, corporate travelers can host conferences, workshops, or private events with ease. Free Wi-Fi and secure parking add extra convenience. In addition, we offer Meeting & Events packages designed for successful business gatherings. Discover details about our Meeting & Events rooms HAOKE Certification Novotel Suites Hanoi is proud to be one of the “HAOKE Certified” hotels. HAOKE is a certification program that ensures Accor’s hotels are ready to welcome Chinese guests. By incorporating Chinese-language, Chinese dishes on menus, Chinese-speaking staff, and other services and payment systems that meet the needs of Chinese travelers. It is the Accor Hotels group’s best service standard for Chinese visitors.
